section.content: 本实用新型公开种锂离子电池组，所述锂离子电池组包括多个锂离子电池及液冷结构，其中，所述多个锂离子电池通过串联和/或并联连接形成电池组单元，所述多个锂离子电池的极耳设在所述电池组单元的上表面的两端，以在所述电池组单元的上表面限定出位于所述多个锂离子电池的极耳之间的安装区域，所述液冷结构，安装于所述安装区域，用以对所述电池组单元进行降温。直接针对该锂离子电池组高温区进行冷却，方便对所述电池组单元的热管理。

The utility model discloses a kind of Li-ion batteries piles, the Li-ion batteries piles include multiple lithium ion batteries and liquid cooling structure, wherein, the multiple lithium ion battery to form battery assembly module by connecting and/or being connected in parallel, the lug of the multiple lithium ion battery is located at the both ends of the upper surface of the battery assembly module, to limit the installation region between the lug of the multiple lithium ion battery in the upper surface of the battery assembly module, the liquid cooling structure, the installation region is installed on, to cool down to the battery assembly module.Cooled down directly against the Li-ion batteries piles high-temperature region, the convenient heat management to the battery assembly module.

Li-ion batteries pilesTechnical field

It the utility model is related to lithium battery thermal management technology field, more particularly to a kind of Li-ion batteries piles.

Background technology

For battery pack in high current in use, fever is all bigger, temperature rise is very serious, particularly the top of battery pack, Temperature increase is higher, not good heat management, be easy to cause that the battery pack temperature difference is big, produces localized hyperthermia, and battery is at high temperature It is very short to be possible to service life, or even thermal runaway, security risk is brought, in order to more rationally, safely carry out heat pipe to battery pack Reason, in the prior art, often carries out heat management using liquid cooling structure to battery pack.

The type of cooling of traditional Li-ion batteries piles be by liquid cooling structure placing battery bottom, in the middle part of battery or side wall, It all cannot preferably realize the heat management to battery pack.

Utility model content

The main purpose of the utility model is to propose a kind of Li-ion batteries piles, it is intended to optimizes the heat to Li-ion batteries piles Management.

To achieve the above object, the utility model proposes Li-ion batteries piles, including：

Multiple lithium ion batteries, battery assembly module, the multiple lithium ion battery are formed by connecting and/or being connected in parallel Lug be located at the battery assembly module upper surface both ends, to be limited in the upper surface of the battery assembly module positioned at institute State the installation region between the lug of multiple lithium ion batteries；And

Liquid cooling structure, is installed on the installation region, to cool down to the battery assembly module.

Preferably, the liquid cooling structure includes：

Thermal conductive insulator, is installed on the installation region；

Liquid cooling pipe, is installed in the thermal conductive insulator；And

Cold liquid, circulates in the liquid cooling pipe.

Preferably, the thermal conductive insulator is one kind in heat conductive silica gel, heat-conducting silicone grease, heat conduction silica gel.

Preferably, the thickness of the thermal conductive insulator is d, and 0.5mm≤d≤3mm.

Preferably, the thermal conductive insulator is bonded in the battery assembly module upper surface, and the liquid cooling pipe is bonded in described Thermal conductive insulator upper surface.

Preferably, the cold liquid is anti-freeze cooling liquid.

Preferably, the material of the liquid cooling pipe is aluminium or copper.

Preferably, the rectangular cross-section of the liquid cooling pipe.

Preferably, the installation region has opposite both sides and opposite both ends, the both ends of the installation region and institute State the lug adjoining of multiple lithium ion batteries；

The liquid cooling pipe includes the curved tube of the U-shaped setting of multistage, and multiple curved tubes are set in parallel, and the liquid cooling pipe Two-port be located at the side of the installation region.

Preferably, the installation region has opposite both sides and opposite both ends, the both ends of the installation region and institute State the lug adjoining of multiple lithium ion batteries；

The liquid cooling pipe includes the curved tube of multiple U-shaped settings, and the multiple curved tube is set in inside and outside, and each curved tube Two ports be directed toward the side of the installation region, the Single port of each curved tube is connected by input pipe, each curved tube Another port connected by efferent duct.

In technical solution provided by the utility model, the multiple lithium ion battery is by connecting and/or being connected in parallel shape Into battery assembly module, the lug of the multiple lithium ion battery is located at the both ends of the upper surface of the battery assembly module, with institute The upper surface for stating battery assembly module limits installation region between the lug of the multiple lithium ion battery, the installation Region corresponds to the high-temperature area of battery assembly module, and liquid cooling structure is installed in the installation region, directly against the high-temperature region into Row cooling, the convenient heat management to the battery assembly module.

Specifically, it is described to lead referring to Fig. 1, the liquid cooling structure 2 includes thermal conductive insulator 21, liquid cooling pipe 22 and cold liquid Heat insulator 21 is installed on the installation region 12, and the liquid cooling pipe 22 is installed on 21 upper surface of thermal conductive insulator, described Cold liquid stream is passed through in the liquid cooling pipe 22, and the thermal conductive insulator 21 is installed on the upper surface of the battery assembly module 1, is risen and is separated The liquid cooling pipe 22 and the battery assembly module 1, the heat that the cold liquid in the liquid cooling pipe 22 constantly produces battery assembly module 1 Amount is exported by thermal conductive insulator 21, the heat management to the battery assembly module 1 is realized, usually, to meet different temperatures The use in section, the material of the cold liquid is anti-freeze cooling liquid.

On the one hand the thermal conductive insulator 21 plays conductive force, on the other hand play insulating effect, insulation is security appliance Ensure, on the premise of ensureing to insulate, conductive force is outwards to export the heat of the battery assembly module 1, heat transfer efficiency Height is also the content of the utility model.

Specifically, the thermal conductive insulator 21 is one kind in heat conductive silica gel, heat-conducting silicone grease, heat conduction silica gel, and use is organic Colloid insulating properties is good, and organic colloid has viscosity, and also easily installation, described to lead in embodiment provided by the utility model Heat insulator 21 is bonded in 1 upper surface of battery assembly module, and the liquid cooling pipe 22 is bonded in 21 upper table of thermal conductive insulator Face, in the battery assembly module 1 in groups, it is only necessary to which the thermal conductive insulator 21 is coated in 1 upper table of battery assembly module Face, then bonding the liquid cooling pipe 22 can complete to assemble, and installation is simple, high in machining efficiency.

Electrical safety by increasing creepage distance, that is, can increase the thickness of the thermal conductive insulator 21 to realize, be limited In heat transfer efficiency as the thickness of the thermal conductive insulator 21 is lower, in embodiment provided by the utility model, the heat conduction The thickness of insulator 21 is d, and 0.5mm≤d≤3mm, within this range, optimum choice heat transfer efficiency and electrical safety.

Heat-shift between the liquid cooling pipe 22 and the thermal conductive insulator 21, in order to improve the liquid cooling pipe 22 and institute State the efficiency of heat exchange between thermal conductive insulator 21, the liquid cooling pipe 22 is using the high material of thermal conductivity factor and improves heat conduction and connects Contacting surface is accumulated, and can improve the effect to exchange heat between the liquid cooling pipe 22 and the thermal conductive insulator 21.

Specifically, the liquid cooling pipe 22 has high thermal conductivity factor, in embodiment provided by the utility model, the liquid The material of cold pipe 22 is aluminium or copper, and high thermal conductivity factor causes heat exchange efficiency to improve, easy to the exchange of heat.

Further, the section of the liquid cooling pipe 22 is set to rectangle so that in 22 unit volume of liquid cooling pipe with it is described Contact area increase between thermal conductive insulator 21, is more advantageous to the exchange of heat, and it is viscous to be conducive to the thermal conductive insulator 21 Knot is fixed.

Further, referring to Fig. 2, in another embodiment provided by the utility model, the installation region 12 has There are opposite both sides and opposite both ends, the both ends of the installation region 12 and the lug 111 of the multiple lithium ion battery 11 Adjacent, the liquid cooling pipe 22 includes the curved tube 221 of the U-shaped setting of multistage, and multiple curved tubes 221 are set in parallel, and described The two-port of liquid cooling pipe 22 is located at the side of the installation region 12, multiple curved tubes 221 so that the liquid cooling pipe 22 and institute The contact area stated between thermal conductive insulator 21 increases, heat exchange amount bigger, is more advantageous to the heat of the Li-ion batteries piles 100 Management.
